node.title: Budget-three fiber-two c=2 outer quartic passes a dyadic torsion-trace gate
node.statement: At quotient order N=2^40, every generic canonical c=2 denominator-mismatch survivor has an outer invariant cubic K_O(Z)=4I^3 Z(Z-36)^2-J^2(Z+12)^3 sharing a root with the N-torsion trace locus. In F[Z]/(K_O), start Q_0=Z-2 and iterate Q_(j+1)=Q_j^2-2 for forty steps. Then gcd(K_O,Q_40-2) is nonconstant. Each remainder has degree at most two, so this outer-only necessary gate uses forty cubic-quotient squarings and no dense Chebyshev or cyclotomic polynomial. Passage does not identify a pair of D_* roots, prove canonical span, or reconstruct a cycle.
